about.title: ABOUT_THIS_JOURNEY
about.whyBody: Most bare-metal learning resources are English-only, and most assume an STM32/ARM background. This curriculum offers a deliberate Arabic-first path from zero to professional, focused on the dirt-cheap (sub-$0.50) RISC-V CH32V003J4M6.
whoList: Developers who know C basics and want to understand hardware bottom-up.
Hobbyists graduating from Arduino into register-level programming.
CS students who want hands-on RISC-V.
Anyone tired of reading and ready to actually build firmware.
about.howBody: Every lesson is verified against the CH32V003 Reference Manual v1.9 (pages cited per reference). Code samples are tested on real hardware (J4M6 package). Everything is written at the register level — no HAL — but with helpful macros from ch32v003fun where useful.
licenseList: Content is open and free — use, share, and remix.
about.authorBody: Shakir Abdo — full-stack developer from Sudan, into embedded systems and low-level tools.

footer.tagline: Bare-metal learning curriculum for the WCH CH32V003 RISC-V chip. Written in Arabic, register-level, RM-verified.

resources.title: RESOURCES
resources.intro: The hardware you need to follow this curriculum, plus the author's other CH32V003 work and ways to support.
resources.hardwareSub: Sub-$5 kit. Anything else (LED, button, breadboard, jumpers) is generic.

wchLinkE.name: WCH-LinkE
wchLinkE.desc: Official WCH programmer + GDB-capable debugger over SDI. Around $3 on AliExpress. Essential — without it you cannot flash the chip or recover a bricked one.

j4m6.name: CH32V003J4M6 (SOP-8)
j4m6.role: Primary chip used in this curriculum
j4m6.desc: The tiniest variant — only 8 pins. Cheapest CH32V003 (~$0.30). Perfect for learning because the pin budget forces you to think.

f4p6.name: CH32V003F4P6 (TSSOP-20)
f4p6.desc: Same silicon, more breakout pins. Use it if you want to play with all peripherals at once. Slightly more expensive (~$0.50).

resources.projectsSub: Related open-source work by the same author. Reuse, learn, contribute.

librariesProj.name: ch32v003j4m6-libraries
librariesProj.desc: A growing collection of register-level libraries for the CH32V003J4M6: GPIO, ADXL345, MPU6050, AHT10, MLX90614, AS5600, Servo, WS2812B, Buzzer, AT24C32 EEPROM, internal-EEPROM emulation, deep-sleep, rotary encoder.

unbrickProj.name: ch32v003-unbrick
unbrickProj.desc: CLI tool to recover a bricked CH32V003 using a WCH-LinkE. Saves you when you accidentally lock the chip.

resources.supportSub: If this curriculum saves you hours, consider supporting future lessons.
